items.question: Qual foi a taxa de internacoes por 100 mil habitantes por UF em 2019?
items.sql: WITH internacoes_por_uf AS (SELECT mu."SG_UF" AS uf, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") = 2019 GROUP BY mu."SG_UF"), populacao_por_uf AS (SELECT m."SG_UF" AS uf, SUM(s."QT_POPULACAO") AS populacao FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios m ON s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE s."NU_ANO" = 2019 GROUP BY m."SG_UF") SELECT i.uf, i.total_internacoes, p.populacao, ROUND(i.total_internacoes * 100000.0 / NULLIF(p.populacao, 0), 2) AS taxa_por_100k FROM internacoes_por_uf i JOIN populacao_por_uf p ON i.uf = p.uf ORDER BY taxa_por_100k DESC;
